protocol.receiver: blind audio-only, auto 600/1200; no manifest or image supplied

limits: Synthetic/offline channels only; no real phone/call/speaker/microphone validation.
Anchor shift includes channel filter/echo effects; decoding success alone is not timing accuracy.
Stress losses are reported, not hidden by changing thresholds.
Not integrated into the production generator or iPhone app.
provenance: DSP parameters frozen after a separate exploratory 24-packet run (noise seed 1901). Holdout used 128 packets and seed 20261026. Actual benchmark driver hash and shipped reproduction wrapper hash are both recorded; the wrapper adds build/provenance checks and passed a separate small packaging run.
